_comment: Node 2 length-reduction audit baseline scenarios for Adaptive Chiropractic (Family A — CATEGORY TABLE template). Covers the fleet's highest-risk Node 2 behaviors: CONFIRM_SERVICE FILLER RULE discipline (HALT-critical per CLAUDE.md), the VARIANT-FIRST mandatory gate question, MENU_LIST zero-preamble output, and PRACTITIONER-ONLY PATH category inference. No prior Node 2 scenarios file existed anywhere in the fleet as of 2026-09-15 — written per .claude/rules/node-edit-verification.md's scenario-writing guidance.

scenarios.name: confirm-service-filler-only — returning patient gate answer 'yes' → single filler phrase then confirm_service, zero narration

history.content: I'd like to book a chiropractic appointment.
Have you had Chiropractic with us before?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Gate question was answered affirmatively (SCAN K / VARIANT-FIRST RULE step 1 outcome B, returning patient). PASS if: agent speaks exactly one filler phrase from the TOOL-CALL FILLER set (e.g. 'One moment.', 'Just a sec.', 'Let me check that.') and nothing else, then calls universal_router intent='confirm_service' with payload containing appointment_type_id='111455', appointment_type='1005 Spinal Adjustment', patient_status='existing', variant_type='followup'. FAIL if: agent says anything beyond the single filler phrase before the tool call (e.g. 'Great, routing you for a returning patient chiropractic appointment', 'Lovely', 'I see', any acknowledgement of the caller's 'yes'). FAIL if: the tool call is missing or uses the wrong appointment_type_id.

scenarios.name: mandatory-gate-before-route — new caller states category directly → must ask VARIANT_SELF gate question, not skip to booking

history.content: Hi, I'd like to book a chiropractic appointment please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller named the CHIROPRACTIC category but has not stated new/existing patient status anywhere in the conversation. PASS if: agent's entire turn is the mandatory gate question 'Have you had Chiropractic with us before?' (or the natural equivalent), with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if: agent calls confirm_service or any tool this turn. FAIL if: agent assumes new-patient status and skips the gate question — absence of stated history must never imply 'new'.

scenarios.name: menu-list-zero-preamble — no service term stated → MENU_LIST output with no opener

history.content: Hi there, I'd like to make a booking please.

scenarios.expected_behavior: No category, symptom, or implied_service is identifiable in the caller's message, and MENU_LIST has not yet been shown this conversation. PASS if: agent's entire spoken turn is the MENU_LIST phrase verbatim ('We offer Chiropractic and Myotherapy — which were you after?' or the exact equivalent), with zero preamble ('I need to ask', 'What brings you in', 'Could I ask', etc.) before it and zero tool calls. FAIL if: any words precede the MENU_LIST phrase. FAIL if: agent asks an open-ended question ('What brings you in today?') instead of outputting the menu.

scenarios.name: practitioner-only-path-myotherapy — caller names Karen with no service term → resolve to Myotherapy silently, skip gate, ask duration naming her

history.content: Can I book in with Karen please?

scenarios.expected_behavior: Caller named practitioner Karen (Fortunato) without naming a service — PRACTITIONER-ONLY PATH applies. Karen offers Myotherapy/Remedial Massage ONLY, and the MYOTHERAPY branch has no new/existing gate question. PASS if: agent skips disambiguation entirely (no 'Have you seen Karen before?' question — that wording is reserved for gated branches like CHIROPRACTIC, not MYOTHERAPY) and instead asks the MYOTHERAPY duration question naming Karen, e.g. 'Would you like a 30, 45, 60, or 90 minute Myotherapy session with Karen, or is this for a Pregnancy Massage?', with ZERO tool calls this turn. FAIL if: agent asks a new/existing gate question for Karen. FAIL if: agent calls confirm_service without first asking the duration question. FAIL if: agent lists Karen's full service menu unprompted.
